item.title: Cabbage Beach Vendors, Plane Crash Victims, Dog Attack
item.ns0:title: Cabbage Beach Vendors, Plane Crash Victims, Dog Attack
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, frustration mounts on Cabbage Beach as vendors demand firm guarantees for their livelihoods following the removal of a controversial shoreline fence. We bring you the emotional stories behind the four family members who tragically lost their lives in a small plane crash off Andros. Plus, fresh public safety concerns ignite after an eleven-year-old boy is hospitalized in another alarming dog attack, while an off-duty officer's brave intervention during a dramatic roadside ordeal catches national attention. Tune in for these top headlines, progress on public school administrator promotions, and your complete sports and weather report.
